title: Long Pressed Name
summary: Determine if a string could be a long-pressed version of a given name, where some characters may be repeated due to long pressing.
statement: Determine if a string could be a long-pressed version of a given name, where some characters may be repeated due to long pressing.
constraints: Typed may repeat a key character beyond its occurrences in name.
Return whether typed can result from long-pressing name.
hints: Each typed character must match the next name character or repeat the prior typed character.
Advance the name pointer on direct matches; otherwise require a long press.
Reject an unmatched new character and finally require every name character consumed.
The scan assigns each typed character to its only possible original or repeated role.
editorial: The scan assigns each typed character to its only possible original or repeated role.

tests.explanation: Extra a and e characters are valid long presses.
The e run is too short, so the typed text is invalid.
